description: Authoritative scientific astronomical visual asset registry for COSMIC ATLAS

assets.name: Earth Photorealistic Day Surface Map
assets.source: NASA Visible Earth & Blue Marble Reference Elevation/Albedo Model
assets.description: Equirectangular 2K color albedo map of Earth featuring bathymetric oceans, continental topography, desert biomes, and polar ice caps.

assets.name: Earth Specular Ocean Mask
assets.description: High-contrast water specular map for physically-based oceanic sun glint.

assets.name: Earth Dynamic Cloud Atmosphere Layer
assets.description: Photorealistic 2K translucent cloud deck featuring cyclone spirals, trade-wind cumulus, and polar vortex eddies.

assets.name: Moon USGS/LRO Lunar Reconnaissance Albedo Map
assets.source: USGS Astrogeology & NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) WAC
assets.description: High-definition 2K lunar surface texture accurately depicting lunar maria, impact basins, and ejecta ray systems.

assets.name: Mars Viking/MGS Scientific Surface Albedo Map
assets.source: NASA Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) MOC & Viking Orbiter
assets.description: Photometrically accurate 2K surface map of Mars featuring Valles Marineris, Olympus Mons, Syrtis Major, and polar carbon-dioxide/water ice caps.

assets.name: Jupiter Cassini/Juno True-Color Atmospheric Map
assets.source: NASA Cassini ISS & JunoCam Science Data
assets.description: True-color 2K cylindrical map of Jupiter's dynamic atmosphere, showing the North/South Equatorial Belts, turbulent festoons, and the Great Red Spot.

assets.name: Saturn Cassini Natural Color Atmosphere Map
assets.description: Calibrated 2K Saturnian atmospheric texture with golden haze banding and north-polar hexagon shadow.

assets.name: Saturn High-Resolution Scientific Ring Profile
assets.source: NASA Cassini Radio Science & ISS Occultation Profiles
assets.description: High-definition radial optical depth and albedo texture of Saturn's ring system detailing A/B/C rings, Cassini Division, and Encke Gap.

assets.name: Sun SDO/AIA Photosphere & Granulation Map
assets.source: NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) AIA & HMI
assets.description: Photorealistic 2K solar surface model featuring convective granulation patterns and magnetic active region sunspot complexes.

assets.name: Betelgeuse ESO-VLT/SPHERE Red Supergiant Surface
assets.source: ESO Very Large Telescope (VLT) / SPHERE & Montargès et al. (2021)
assets.description: Reconstructed 2K red supergiant stellar surface depicting colossal convective plume cells and asymmetric dust cooling.

assets.name: Andromeda Galaxy (M31) High-Definition Disk Model
assets.source: NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope & GALEX Composite
assets.description: High-definition 1K spiral galaxy disk texture featuring bright Population II stellar bulge, dust extinction lanes, and star-forming spiral arms.

assets.name: Carina Nebula (NGC 3372) Multi-Wavelength Emission Map
assets.source: NASA/ESA Hubble Heritage & ESO VLT Hawk-I Infrared/Optical
assets.description: Rich multi-wavelength emission cloud texture showcasing ionized hydrogen (H-alpha) cavities, O-III filaments, and cold dust absorption pillars.
